title: TargetDescriptor
description: One debugging target, as the static side (Ghidra) and the dynamic side (x64dbg) each see it. The conversion between the two address spaces is runtime = static - image_base + module_base; the identity fields exist so that a consumer can refuse the conversion when the two sides are not looking at the same file.

contract_version.description: The version of this shape. A consumer refuses a version it does not know.

schema.description: The file this document claims to follow.

binary.description: The path of the file the static side has open. The identity of the target.

binary_name.description: The file name of binary, for a display that has no room for the path.

arch.description: The architecture as the static side names it (Ghidra language id, eg x86:LE:64:default).

image_base.description: The address the image is built to load at. The anchor of the static address space.

module_base.description: Where the loader actually put the module. Null when only the static side is known, in which case nothing may be translated.

module_path.description: The path the debugger reports for the loaded module. Compared with binary to decide identity.

session.description: How to reach the dynamic side (host, port, debugger version).

source.description: How to reach the static side (host, port, plugin version).

delta.description: module_base - image_base, the constant the conversion adds. Null when module_base is unknown.

same_binary.description: True only when both sides name the same file by the same normalised path.

match.description: How the two paths relate. name-only is a copy, a symlink or a rebuild: not the same target.

reason.description: Why the identity is what it is, in words a log can carry.

correlatable.description: Whether the conversion may be used: same binary, a positive image base and a known module base. A consumer must not translate when this is false.
